examples: Your main achievements will be listed in your personnel file.
Joseph's achievements in R&D will go down in company history.

vocabulary.definition: to add to; to donate, to give
examples: Make sure your boss is aware of the work you contributed to the project.
All employees are asked to contribute a few minutes of their spare time to clean up the office.
The director's dedication to a high-quality product has motivated many of his employees.
We would never be where we are today if it weren't for many long hours and so much dedication.

vocabulary.definition: to anticipate, to be eager for something to happen
examples: The regional director was looking forward to the new, larger offices.
We look forward to seeing you at the next meeting.

vocabulary.definition: to depend on, to rely on
examples: The workers always looked to him to settle their disagreements.
The staff is looking to their supervisor for guidance and direction.

vocabulary.definition: faithful, believing in someone or something
examples: You have been such a loyal advisor for so many years, I'm not sure what I'll do without you.
Even though your assistant is loyal, you have to question his job performance.
Employees are evaluated on their merit and not on seniority.
Your work has improved tremendously and is of great merit.
Her tardiness was obviously resented by her coworkers.
This is obviously not the first time that the customer has had problems with this particular model of sander.
The researcher wasn't as productive when he first started working here.
The managers had a very productive meeting and were able to solve many of the problems.

vocabulary.definition: to give someone a better job; to support, to make known
examples: Even though the sales associate had a good year, it wasn't possible to promote him.
The assistant director promoted the idea that the director was incompetent.

vocabulary.definition: credit, praise for doing something well
examples: The president's personal assistant was finally given the recognition that she has deserved for many years.
Recognition of excellent work should be routine for every manager.
Employees value their colleagues' opinions.
The expert valued the text at $7,000.
